movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Blaze Kick
movelist.effect: Blaze Kick Burns the target on 19+, and is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Bulk Up
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Flame Charge
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Klutz
abilities.trigger: The user hits with a Melee Attack
abilities.effect: Choose one of the target’s Held Items or Accessory Slot Items. It is knocked to the ground.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Speed is raised 1 Combat Stage at the end of each of its turns. Speed Boost has no effect while out of combat.

abilities.name: Moxie
abilities.effect: Whenever the user’s Move causes a target to faint, it may raise its Attack Combat Stage by +1. You may only trigger Moxie once per Move, even if the Move causes multiple targets to faint.
